title: NeoOrigins Origin
description: An origin the player can pick. File path: data/<namespace>/origins/origins/<origin>.json.

name.description: Display name (translation key or literal). Defaults to origins.<namespace>.<origin>.name.

description.description: Display description (translation key or literal). Defaults to origins.<namespace>.<origin>.description.

icon.description: Item ID shown in the picker card. String form is shorthand for {item: ...}.

impact.description: Gameplay impact tier shown in the picker.

order.description: Sort order within the layer — lower = earlier.

powers.description: Power IDs granted when this origin is chosen. All must resolve to power JSONs under data/<namespace>/origins/powers/.

unchoosable.description: If true, not shown in the picker (granted only programmatically).

hidden.description: Origins-format synonym for unchoosable — only honored when the file is detected as Origins-format and translated. NeoOrigins-format files should use unchoosable.

special.description: If true, marks the origin as special (e.g. evolution/upgrade targets) for picker presentation.

required_mods.description: Mod ids that must all be loaded for this origin to load. When any are absent the origin is skipped entirely (never registered or shown).

spawn_location.description: Preferred first-spawn / respawn placement filter. dimension / structure / structure_tag combine with AND; biome, biome_tag and biomes combine with OR.

tier_powers.description: Evolution-tier power overlays. At a given tier, powers in add are granted and powers in remove are revoked. Overlays stack cumulatively (tier 2 includes tier 1's changes).

figura_model.description: Opaque base model key handed to the Figura soft-dep Lua sandbox (neoorigins:getFiguraModel). NeoOrigins never interprets it. See docs/FIGURA.md.

figura_models.description: Advanced reactive Figura-model maps. All keys and values are opaque strings surfaced to the Figura Lua sandbox; NeoOrigins never interprets them. See docs/FIGURA.md.

tiers.description: Evolution-tier index (as a string integer) to model key. The highest index at most the player's tier wins over the base figura_model.

powers.description: Power id to model key. The key is on while that power is active on the player.

capabilities.description: Capability tag to model key. The key is on while that capability tag is present on the player.

vocab.description: Model key to friendly label, purely for avatar-side discovery.
